method.rule: Smallest observed positive own-policy calibration growth at or above max(existing raw P75, existing 0.10 floor). Do not round it upward to a 0.05 grid.
method.score_curve: Linear cap at the selected target; no headroom or twice-target challenge.

normal_policy_completed_record.note: Archived completed execution; final evidence alone does not contain every pre-investment guard snapshot.

limitations: The correction restores observed development steps. It does not equalize wins, investment counts, cost, or difficulty.
Full target score frequency can increase. That alone is neither fairness nor unfairness.
Archived successful paths prove feasibility only under their stated calibration policies and market trajectory.
Invest policy waives the normal cash reserve and household guard; any such witness is explicitly identified.
The relaxed state enumeration proves structural reachability, not affordability.
The official source goals remain byte-for-byte unchanged; these are candidate score-view targets.
